name: Hospital Landscape Design Preferences (Trojanowska et al. 2025)
description:
Faithful replication of Trojanowska, M., Matuszewska, J., & Brosz, M. (2025). Investigating the Preferences for Hospital Landscape Design: Results of a Pilot Study from Poland. Architecture 5:91. https://doi.org/10.3390/architecture5040091

What should hospital grounds look like? Participants answer questions on contact with nature (yes/no items, frequency, 1–10 and 1–5 importance ratings), then choose their favourites in ten picture questions built from the authors' own photographs of real gardens: two sets of six garden types, eight path surfaces, natural vs designed landscape, four garden compositions, lawn vs flower parterre, lawn vs water pond, four interior sizes, terrace atrium vs pocket park, and four bench settings (single or multiple choice as in the paper). They then tick, from 36 adjectives, how the surroundings of healthcare facilities are now and how they should be, and give recommendations. In the original pilot (110 respondents, Poland, 2024) people preferred calm, ordered designs, flower parterres and ponds over lawn, smaller interiors, pocket parks and sheltered seats.

Photographs: the 40 photographs printed in Figures 1–10 (CC BY 4.0, "Source: Author"), cut from the high-resolution figures. Credited to the authors; the template is removed if they object.

Differences from the original study: (1) the original form was in Polish and is not published; the question wording here is an English rendering of the paper's descriptions, tables and figure captions; (2) the anchors of the 1–10 and 1–5 ratings are not reported and were written for this template; (3) the paper's 38 questions are not all described: the opinions on a tree view from the window and on interior winter gardens are left out, and the list of recreational facilities is asked as one open question; (4) each picture question is shown on its own screen.
author: Trojanowska, Matuszewska & Brosz

        "value": 1,
        "text": "Yes"
       },
       {
        "value": 2,
        "text": "No"
       }
      ]
     }
    ]
   }
  ]
 }
}
</script>
<style>
:root{--bg:#eef2ef;--card:#fff;--ink:#1f2421;--muted:#59625c;--accent:#2e6a57;--accent-ink:#fff;--line:#d3dbd6;--warn:#b3261e}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
main{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px 16px 40px}
h1{font-size:1.3rem;margin:0 0 10px}
p{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--muted)}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;margin-top:14px}
.btn{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 20px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.q{margin-top:20px}.q:first-child{margin-top:0}.q>b{display:block;margin-bottom:6px}.on{font-weight:400;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem}
label.opt{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin-top:6px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--card)}
.adj{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:0 8px}
textarea{font:inherit;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;width:100%;min-height:72px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
.top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px}
.t{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.bar{height:5px;background:var(--line);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;flex:1;margin-left:12px;max-width:260px}.bar>i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent)}
.grid{display:grid;gap:10px;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.grid.n6,.grid.n8{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.grid.n8{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
.tile{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card)}
.tile input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.tile img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.tile span{display:block;flex:1;padding:6px 10px;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600}
.tile:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent)}
.tile:has(input:checked) span{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.tile:has(input:focus-visible){outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.seg{display:grid;gap:4px}
.seg label{display:block;cursor:pointer;position:relative}
.seg input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.seg span{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:40px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;font-weight:600}
.seg input:checked+span{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.seg input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.anch{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.err{color:var(--warn);margin-top:8px;min-height:1.2em}
.credit{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 24px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted)}
@media (max-width:640px){.grid.n6,.grid.n8{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.grid.n2,.grid.n4{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main id="app" aria-live="polite"><p>Loading…</p></main>
<footer class="credit">Photographs: Trojanowska, Matuszewska & Brosz (2025), Architecture 5:91, Figures 1–10, doi:10.3390/architecture5040091 (CC BY 4.0). Used with credit for research; removed if the authors object.</footer>
<script>
(function(){
  var KEY='hospgarden2025:';
  var app=document.getElementById('app'), Q={}, files={}, SPEC=null, steps=[], done={};
  function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"'}[c];});}
  function err(m){var e=app.querySelector('.err');if(e){e.textContent=m||'';e.style.visibility='visible';}}
  function hideErr(){var e=app.querySelector('.err');if(e)e.style.visibility='hidden';}
  function ok(r){return !(r&&r.ok===false);}
  function load(k){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY+k));}catch(e){return null;}}
  function save(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY+k,JSON.stringify(v));}catch(e){}}
  function q(n){return Q[n]||{};}
  function page(html,btn,cb){
    app.innerHTML=html+'<div style="margin-top:18px"><button class="btn" id="go">'+esc(btn||'Continue')+'</button></div><div class="err"></div>';
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=cb;app.onchange=hideErr;
  }
  function field(n){
    var d=q(n),h='<div class="q" data-q="'+n+'"><b>'+esc(d.title)+(d.isRequired?'':' <span class="on">(optional)</span>')+'</b>';
    if(d.figure){
      var multi=d.type==='checkbox';
      h+='<div class="grid n'+d.choices.length+'">'+d.choices.map(function(c){var f=files[c.image];return '<label class="tile"><input type="'+(multi?'checkbox':'radio')+'" name="'+n+'" value="'+esc(c.value)+'"><img alt="'+esc(c.text)+'" src="'+esc(f?f.url:'')+'"><span>'+esc(c.text)+'</span></label>';}).join('')+'</div>';
    }else if(d.type==='rating'){
      var v=[];for(var i=d.rateMin;i<=d.rateMax;i++)v.push(i);
      h+='<div class="seg" style="grid-template-columns:repeat('+v.length+',1fr)">'+v.map(function(x){return '<label><input type="radio" name="'+n+'" value="'+x+'"><span>'+x+'</span></label>';}).join('')+'</div><div class="anch"><span>'+d.rateMin+' = '+esc(d.minRateDescription)+'</span><span>'+d.rateMax+' = '+esc(d.maxRateDescription)+'</span></div>';
    }else if(d.type==='comment'){
      h+='<textarea name="'+n+'"></textarea>';
    }else{
      var multi2=d.type==='checkbox';
      h+='<div class="'+(d.choices.length>12?'adj':'')+'">'+d.choices.map(function(c){return '<label class="opt"><input type="'+(multi2?'checkbox':'radio')+'" name="'+n+'" value="'+esc(c.value)+'"> '+esc(c.text)+'</label>';}).join('')+'</div>';
    }
    return h+'</div>';
  }
  function read(n){
    var d=q(n);
    if(d.type==='comment'){var t=app.querySelector('textarea[name="'+n+'"]').value.trim();return t?t:undefined;}
    var xs=[].slice.call(app.querySelectorAll('input[name="'+n+'"]:checked')).map(function(x){return d.figure?x.value:Number(x.value);});
    if(d.type==='checkbox')return xs.length?xs:undefined;
    return xs.length?xs[0]:undefined;
  }
  function next(){
    window.scrollTo(0,0);
    if(!done.intro)return intro();
    for(var i=0;i<steps.length;i++){if(!done[steps[i].id])return step(steps[i],i);}
    finish();
  }
  function intro(){
    var miss=[];SPEC.pages.forEach(function(p){p.elements.forEach(function(e){(e.figure?e.choices:[]).forEach(function(c){if(!files[c.image])miss.push(c.image);});});});
    if(miss.length){app.innerHTML='<h1>Pictures missing</h1><p>Media folder gardens must hold the 40 photographs f1_a.jpg … f10_d.jpg.</p>';return;}
    page('<h1>Gardens on hospital grounds</h1><p>This survey asks how the outdoor space around hospitals and other healthcare facilities should look. You will answer a few questions about contact with nature, choose your favourite gardens from photographs, and describe the surroundings of healthcare facilities as they are and as they should be.</p><p>It takes about 10–15 minutes. The survey is anonymous; no names are recorded.</p>'+
      '<div class="card"><label class="opt" style="margin-top:0"><input type="checkbox" id="ok"> '+esc(q('consent').title)+'</label></div>','Start',function(){
      if(!document.getElementById('ok').checked)return err('Please confirm to continue.');
      var b=this;b.disabled=true;SPSite.answer('consent',true).then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){b.disabled=false;return err(r.error);}done.intro=true;save('d',done);next();});
    });
  }
  function step(s,i){
    var bar='<div class="top"><span class="t">'+esc(s.title)+'</span><div class="bar"><i style="width:'+(100*i/steps.length)+'%"></i></div></div>';
    page(bar+'<div class="card">'+s.names.map(field).join('')+'</div>',i===steps.length-1?'Finish':'Continue',function(){
      var l=[];for(var k=0;k<s.names.length;k++){var n=s.names[k],v=read(n);if(v===undefined){if(q(n).isRequired)return err('Please answer: '+q(n).title);continue;}l.push([n,v]);}
      var b=this;b.disabled=true;
      Promise.all(l.map(function(a){return SPSite.answer(a[0],a[1]);})).then(function(rs){var bad=rs.filter(function(r){return !ok(r);})[0];if(bad){b.disabled=false;return err(bad.error);}done[s.id]=true;save('d',done);next();});
    });
  }
  function finish(){
    app.innerHTML='<h1>Thank you!</h1><div class="card"><p>In the original pilot study (110 respondents in Poland, spring 2024), 96% said the surroundings of a healthcare building affect patients’ health. Respondents leaned towards calm, ordered design: an ordered composition with formed topiary (55%), paths in the park (73%), stabilized alleys (50%), a calm composition (69%), smaller interiors (47%), a pocket park over a small terrace atrium (79%) and a sheltered sitting place (63%). Flower parterres and water ponds were preferred over lawn, while natural and designed landscapes split almost evenly (48% vs 52%). Today’s hospital surroundings were most often called monotonous, neutral or sad; the ideal ones should provide relief, promote regeneration and be joyful.</p><p style="font-size:.82rem">Trojanowska, M., Matuszewska, J., & Brosz, M. (2025). Investigating the Preferences for Hospital Landscape Design: Results of a Pilot Study from Poland. Architecture 5:91, doi:10.3390/architecture5040091.</p><p id="fin">Submitting…</p><div class="err"></div></div>';
    SPSite.complete().then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){err(r.error||'Some answers are missing.');var m=r.missing||[];setTimeout(function(){m.forEach(function(x){if(x==='consent')done.intro=false;steps.forEach(function(s){if(s.names.indexOf(x)>=0)done[s.id]=false;});});save('d',done);next();},1800);}
      else{var s=document.getElementById('fin');if(s)s.textContent='Your answers have been saved. You can close this window now.';}});
  }
  SPSite.onReady(function(ctx){
    try{SPEC=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('sp-scheme').textContent).survey;}catch(e){SPEC={pages:[]};}
    SPEC.pages.forEach(function(p){
      p.elements.forEach(function(e){var g=SPSite.getQuestion(e.name)||{};var c=e.choices;Q[e.name]={type:e.type,title:g.title||e.title,isRequired:e.isRequired,choices:c,figure:e.figure,rateMin:e.rateMin,rateMax:e.rateMax,minRateDescription:e.minRateDescription,maxRateDescription:e.maxRateDescription};});
      if(p.name==='intro')return;
      if(p.name==='photos')p.elements.forEach(function(e,k){steps.push({id:'ph'+k,title:p.title+' · '+(k+1)+' of '+p.elements.length,names:[e.name]});});
      else if(p.name==='adjectives')p.elements.forEach(function(e,k){steps.push({id:'adj'+k,title:p.title+' · '+(k+1)+' of 2',names:[e.name]});});
      else steps.push({id:p.name,title:p.title,names:p.elements.map(function(e){return e.name;})});
    });
    (SPSite.getMedia('gardens')||[]).forEach(function(f){files[f.name]=f;});
    var a=(ctx&&ctx.answers)||{};done=load('d')||{};
    done.intro=a.consent===true;
    steps.forEach(function(s){done[s.id]=s.names.every(function(n){return !q(n).isRequired||a[n]!=null;});});
    next();
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

config.description: Faithful replication of Trojanowska, Matuszewska & Brosz (2025), Architecture 5:91: an online survey on hospital landscape design with the authors' 40 garden photographs (ten picture questions), attitudes to contact with nature, and 36 adjectives for the actual and expected surroundings of healthcare facilities.

paper.title: Investigating the Preferences for Hospital Landscape Design: Results of a Pilot Study from Poland
